metadata.name: oilskin
metadata.description: Oilskin Solana module — program-owned Kamino obligation with a scoped, revocable keeper grant (scaffold; no handlers until docs/SOLANA-ARCHITECTURE.md is approved)

instructions.name: borrow
docs: Borrow USDC into the Account; refused unless HF ≥ the entry floor and LTV ≤ the offer afterwards.

instructions.name: close_position
docs: Repay everything then withdraw everything.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Wallet ZEC → Account → Kamino collateral.

accounts.name: obligation
docs: this instruction re-creates it (same PDA) before depositing.

instructions.name: grant
docs: Create or overwrite a keeper's grant.

instructions.name: init_account
docs: Create the Account PDA, its ZEC and USDC token accounts, and the Kamino user metadata + obligation it owns.

instructions.name: keeper_protect
docs: The keeper's one instruction: inside a live grant, at a crossed rung, repay from the Account's USDC and
release collateral to the keeper only against a Scope-priced payment already made.

accounts.name: account
docs: Writable because klend's V2 deposit/withdraw list the obligation owner as writable.

instructions.name: repay
docs: Repay USDC from the Account (`u64::MAX` = all).

instructions.name: revoke
docs: Kill one keeper's grant.

instructions.name: revoke_all
docs: Kill every grant at once (epoch bump).

instructions.name: transfer_out
docs: Any token from the Account's ATA to the wallet. Owner-only, no other gate.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Withdraw collateral (cToken units; `u64::MAX` = all) to the Account; refused below the exit floor unless the debt is dust.

errors.name: NotOwner
errors.msg: Only the account owner may do this

errors.name: OwnerIsPda
errors.msg: The wallet is a program-derived address; an account owner must be a signing key

errors.name: EntryHfTooLow
errors.msg: Health factor after this action is below the entry floor

errors.name: LtvAboveOffer
errors.msg: Loan-to-value after this borrow is above what Oilskin offers for this collateral

errors.name: ExitHfTooLow
errors.msg: Health factor after this withdraw is below the exit floor and the debt is not dust

errors.name: ObligationStale
errors.msg: The obligation was not refreshed in this slot

errors.name: PriceNotChecked
errors.msg: The reserve's price was not fully checked at its last refresh

errors.name: HealthOverflow
errors.msg: Health arithmetic overflowed

errors.name: UnexpectedKaminoLayout
errors.msg: Kamino account layout is not the one this program was built against

errors.name: WrongKaminoAccount
errors.msg: A Kamino account is not the one this market uses

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidGrant
errors.msg: Grant parameters are invalid

errors.name: GrantNotLive
errors.msg: The grant is not live (expired, revoked, or from an older epoch)

errors.name: RungNotAllowed
errors.msg: This rung is not allowed by the grant

errors.name: RungIsNotifyOnly
errors.msg: The warn rung is notify-only: there is no on-chain action for it

errors.name: UnknownRung
errors.msg: Unknown rung id

errors.name: RungNotCrossed
errors.msg: The named rung is not crossed: the account is healthier than that

errors.name: RungUnderstated
errors.msg: A more severe rung is crossed than the one named

errors.name: RepayBudgetExceeded
errors.msg: Repay budget for this period is exhausted

errors.name: SellBudgetExceeded
errors.msg: Sell budget for this period is exhausted or selling is not permitted by the grant

errors.name: ProtectionIneffective
errors.msg: The action did not lift the health factor to the rung's disarm level and no budget was exhausted

errors.name: SaleBelowFloor
errors.msg: Sale proceeds are below the Scope-priced floor

errors.name: NotRevocable
errors.msg: Nothing to revoke: no grant exists for this keeper

errors.name: GrantStillLive
errors.msg: A live grant exists; revoke it before releasing the obligation

errors.name: InsufficientUsdcToClose
errors.msg: The account's USDC balance cannot cover the debt

errors.name: WrongTokenAccount
errors.msg: Token account is not the account's associated token account for that mint

types.name: Grant
docs: A keeper's delegation. The keeper may call `keeper_protect` and nothing else, inside these bounds.

fields.name: epoch
docs: Must equal `UserAccount.grant_epoch` to be live.

fields.name: expiry_ts
docs: Unix seconds; 0 after `revoke`.

fields.name: repay_usdc_per_period
docs: USDC base units the keeper may repay from the account's idle USDC per period.

fields.name: sell_zec_per_period
docs: ZEC base units the keeper may sell per period to repay (0 = never sell collateral).

fields.name: max_sell_slippage_bps
docs: Floor on a sale: proceeds ≥ Scope price × amount × (1 − this).

fields.name: allowed_rungs
docs: Bitmask over ladder rung ids (bit i = rung id i may be acted on).

types.name: UserAccount
docs: The user's account. `owner` is set once by `init_account` and never changes.

fields.name: owner
docs: The wallet that owns this account. Immutable.

fields.name: grant_epoch
docs: Bumped by `revoke_all`; a Grant is live only while its `epoch` equals this.

fields.name: obligation
docs: The Kamino obligation this account owns (PDA of klend, owner = this account).
